query:
SELECT state_code, district_label, status, called_winner, called_party, pct_reporting, candidate1_name, candidate1_party, candidate1_votes, candidate2_name, candidate2_party, candidate2_votes, primary_date, updated_at FROM house_races WHERE state_code IN ('WV','NE') ORDER BY state_code, district;
SELECT state_code, status, called_winner, called_party, pct_reporting, candidate1_name, candidate1_votes, candidate2_name, candidate2_votes, primary_date, updated_at FROM senate_races WHERE state_code IN ('WV','NE','NJ') ORDER BY state_code;
